# R14c fixtures (synthetic)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py::phenotype_design` (seeded standard-library values; no study
data): groups A and B, a continuous covariate `age` and a numeric phenotype `score`.

- `linear`: F01-F10 rise 0.4 log2 per phenotype unit; group B shifts F11-F15; age adds 0.02 per year.
- `missing=k`: the phenotype is missing for the first k units (complete-case exclusion, never imputation).
- `one_group`: the phenotype is recorded only in group B (a pooled association is aliased with group).
- `simpson`: overlapping phenotype ranges (A 1-7, B 4-10); F01-F05 fall 0.4 per unit within each group while group B is
  6 log2 higher, so the unadjusted pooled slope is positive and the within-group slopes are negative.
